visualLanguage: design_system/public/PUBLIC_UI.md, built from components/site/v3 only. This directory holds NO index.html: the monthly report archive never had a bespoke mockup, and its visual target is the pattern set, not a picture. The contract below binds the route's component set (ci:mockup-parity) and its section plan (ci:page-purpose).
competitiveTarget: The citable home of the Central Oregon monthly market report. Beat the Bend brokerages' market-update posts (text-heavy, no chart, no market table, archive as a plain blog sidebar) and the portals' metro pages (a few KPI tiles and one chart): the latest edition answered in the first viewport with its four figures and an interrogable 36-month median line, the edition's own PDF one tap away, and every edition since January 2006 addressable by month on one calendar, each month shaded by its Central Oregon median and revealing its first headline sentence on hover, keyboard focus or a phone's press and hold, with the source trace under every figure.
note: Authored 2026-09-25 with the taste pass that broke the page's repeated eyebrow-then-heading beat (separate evaluator, defect 4) and gave the calendar's reveal to phones (defect 2). Rhythm: no two adjacent sections share a pattern. Every figure is read from a published edition's frozen payload through lib/data/market-report/editions and formatted by the PDF's own helpers (lib/market-report/format), so the archive, the edition page and the PDF print one number per fact; nothing here computes a market statistic. With nothing published the page renders one honest Quiet and is noindex. No tasteReview yet: a separate evaluator owes it.

With nothing published, one level-1 V3Quiet.
